states.label: Focused Symptom Correlation and Diagnostic Clarity
states.description: Correlates presenting symptoms with potential diagnoses through rigorous analysis, emphasizing clarity and coherence to avoid diagnostic ambiguity and oversight.

states.label: Holistic Clinical Synthesis
states.description: Integrates patient history, symptoms, and diagnostic findings into a cohesive clinical picture to construct a comprehensive understanding of the patient's health status.

states.label: Structured Exploration of Differential Diagnoses by Clinical Context
states.description: Systematically explores differential diagnoses by carefully considering the clinical context, patient-specific factors, and available evidence to articulate a refined list of possibilities.

states.label: Causal Interpretation of Clinical Symptoms
states.description: Interprets clinical symptoms by reasoning about underlying causal mechanisms, distinguishing strong associations from coincidental correlations to enhance diagnostic accuracy.

states.label: Holistic Clinical Interpretation
states.description: Discerns meaningful connections among diverse clinical data points—including symptoms, history, and test results—to form a coherent diagnostic interpretation that explains the patient's condition.
